statement: The existing CDC delayUntilShutdown owner retains exact timer and shutdown-registration custody through normal firing, shutdown, failed acquisition, failed cancellation and shutdown during acquisition. One delay cancels only through its acquiring clock. Normal completion resolves; acquisition and cancellation faults reject with their original cause without blocking another registered delay. Rejection does not certify that a failed cancellation released its timer.

constraints.statement: Change only delayUntilShutdown and its adjacent contract comment in cdc-integration-service-lifecycle.js. Preserve the existing TimeSource and Promise APIs, delay durations and callers. Add no timer, retry, compatibility branch, exported API, relister registration or alternate lifecycle owner.

Preserve original causes and the difference between promise settlement, deregistration and actual timer release. Label injected acquisition reentry and clock replacement as admitted-seam controls, not ordinary platform-clock incidents. Retain exact historical and newly measured original/candidate identities. Run all tests, generators and static gates only on physical lab machines through the sole coordinator.
